description: This file defines types for managing browser server state and profiles, including runtime states, actions, profile status, and server context types used in a browser automation framework.

classes.name: ProfileRuntimeState
classes.description: Represents the runtime state of a single profile's Chrome instance, including profile info, current running Chrome, last targeted tab, and reconciliation info.

classes.name: BrowserServerState
classes.description: Holds the overall server state, including server object, port, configuration, and active profiles.

classes.name: ProfileContext
classes.description: Provides profile information along with associated actions such as tab management and browser control.

classes.name: ProfileStatus
classes.description: Contains status info about a profile, including name, transport, cdp info, color, driver, and runtime info.

classes.name: ContextOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring the browser context, including state retrieval and optional hooks for attach target handling.

methods.name: ensureBrowserAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that the browser is available for the profile.

methods.name: ensureTabAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that a tab is available, optionally targeting a specific ID.

methods.name: isHttpReachable
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP endpoint is reachable within an optional timeout.

methods.name: isReachable
methods.description: Checks if the browser is reachable within an optional timeout.

methods.name: listTabs
methods.description: Lists all open tabs in the browser.

methods.name: openTab
methods.description: Opens a new tab with a specified URL.

methods.name: focusTab
methods.description: Brings a tab with the specified target ID into focus.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes the tab with the specified target ID.

methods.name: resetProfile
methods.description: Resets the profile, potentially moving profiles from one location to another.

methods.name: listProfiles
methods.description: Returns a list of profiles' status information.

methods.name: mapTabError
methods.description: Converts an error encountered during tab operations into a standardized status object.

methods.name: forProfile
methods.description: Retrieves context for a specific profile by name.
